method: Inspect exact production diff and Java sources; enumerate renderer branch/numeric expressions not matched by a whitespace-normalized parent line multiset, excluding test-only items from production conclusions. Moved unchanged code is not falsely called a new literal. Inventory is a navigation aid, not an acceptance gate.
model_file_change: Clone derives only; required for render-local lowering, no fixture/input discrimination.

sections.name: Component dimensions and multiline guards
sections.assessment: New folded-note shadow width and right margin5 have direct citations. Guard line splitting has Display citation. Existing inherited font sizes/metrics were not retuned. Over-several span still omits participant shadow; see focused shadow controls.

sections.name: Teoz all-history depth
sections.assessment: Max-depth arithmetic is sourced but accepted legacy variations are not the full Java event history. Counterexamples reject the data-flow equivalence.

sections.name: Shared self geometry
sections.assessment: Forward delta/start/width algebra is sourced. Reverse direction is missing from the shared value; fresh reverse-definition controls fail.

sections.name: Recursive winning members
sections.assessment: Member identity cached before translation and kind margin afterward is source-faithful. Minimum ties remain an unproven corner because Java iterates a HashSet and Rust an ordered vector; no tie-specific failure is asserted. Complete envelope still depends on failing component widths.

sections.name: Return and lifecycle ownership
sections.assessment: External real-participant selection, return-owned deactivation, and independent lifecycle flags are cited. Teoz ordinates remain supplied by a legacy combined-row scheduler; return optional color is not represented.

sections.name: Shadow painting
sections.assessment: Added filter fields reuse resolved sequence shadow state and do not read golden output. No new shadow magnitude was invented.

sections.name: Preferred padded metrics
sections.assessment: New named COMMENT_RESERVED_HEIGHT=15 exactly matches Java. Padding is added twice for the block sides. The global style branch and empty-comment cases have scoped evidence; whole-source padding still fails.

sections.name: Event scheduling
sections.assessment: Standalone padded note and group flows are accounted. Attached notes retain separate ad hoc scheduling, and self-note branch does not include the same padding origin as other notes. Fresh note and Teoz histories reject full scheduling.

sections.name: Return lowering
sections.assessment: Clone retains event indices and source lines. Each recursive render removes at least one Return; termination has a strict decreasing measure. Color parsing omission is demonstrated by fresh raw-Java controls.

sections.name: Constraints and shared self envelopes
sections.assessment: Forward width includes the start live segment, with a further segment reservation in ConstraintAfter; last-border branch is accounted. Reverse ConstraintBefore envelope is not represented by SequenceSelfArrow. Removed create/destroy pad constants are a structural improvement, not proof of parity.

sections.name: Note live envelopes
sections.assessment: 4*ROSE_NOTE_PADDING_Y is documented as two marginY plus two paddingY contributions; shadow and global text padding are separate. Uses full preferred component edges for legacy; Teoz still consumes ordinate-based unions rather than full event-history modes.

sections.name: Group membership and tiled bounds
sections.assessment: Raw and translated evaluation reuses one closure with cached winning identities; this deliberate two-pass measurement is not duplicate independent policy. However component bounds are duplicated elsewhere, and participant shadow is still omitted from spanning-note width. Teoz life arithmetic is source-derived but its accepted-variation inputs are incomplete.

sections.name: Missing-space and page translation
sections.assessment: Single missing-space push and legacy reevaluation are supported. Teoz min_tile separately reconstructs notes and groups and misses exo origin behavior. Legacy midpoint chrome logic was removed; its Teoz branch remains and is contradicted by page controls.

sections.name: Final envelopes and all-page activations
sections.assessment: Preferred width versus actual width is correctly distinguished in the self-note wrapper. Multiple note extent reconstructions remain. The raw_note_content_w.fract()>0.57 branch is inherited unchanged and remains a pre-existing unexplained workaround on still-reachable Teoz paths; this review does not bless it.

sections.name: Chrome composition
sections.assessment: Right margin5 and child centering /2 are sourced. Added +1 TextBlockBordered trailing unit, +3 caption (two unit margins plus trailing unit), and title padding are described at the new block. This only fixes horizontal composition; vertical caption still starts at the undecorated tail and ignores preceding legend height. Focused counterexamples reject complete composition.

sections.name: Activation clipping and background shadow
sections.assessment: Clipping preserves title/group wrappers. The +2 body-bottom expression is tied to the existing tail/separator coordinate convention; the adjacent comment names the clipping method but does not independently derive that conversion. No isolated acceptance is issued. Four legacy page controls pass; Teoz and combined chrome fail.

sections.name: Teoz ordinary message endpoints
sections.assessment: The depth==1 / depth>2 branches and subtract2 are literal Java control flow, not a fixture-shaped depth ladder. The caller approximates IGNORE_FUTURE_DEACTIVATE by max(before,at); failing event histories mean that input is not generally equivalent.

sections.name: Self strokes and direction
sections.assessment: One-unit ASYNC stroke adjustment after lifecycle delta is directly sourced. Half-head branch shares ASYNC dressing. Legacy flag-based component delta works in forward controls; reverse start/envelope and Teoz explicit-flag histories fail. No text-label keyed branch found.

sections.name: Note component painting
sections.assessment: Body-coordinate truncation before page translation is source-derived. Multiple paint/extent formulas omit shadow/padding in different places. The participant-span and attached-note failures expose this duplication. Existing note origin clamps are retained, not independently justified.

sections.name: Group and footer painting
sections.assessment: Padding added to inherited guard positions reuses existing decimal baselines; decimal counts do not increase. Immediate comments at the changed12.634765625/12.63475 offsets do not state a Java metric derivation, so adjacent provenance is incomplete despite account-level references. New page-text-center condition is sourced, but multiline caption and vertical wrapper composition remain wrong.

No model acceptance follows from the absence of decimal-ratchet growth.
fixture_logic: No new shipping golden-file reads, include_str fixture replay, label-text keyed conditions, SVG coordinate string surgery, or invented branch-count constant ladder found. Maker label strings in parser/unit tests are not shipping discriminators. Existing historical heuristics remain reachable; they are listed as unresolved instead of silently legitimized.
duplication: Self width/start sharing and one two-pass group closure reduce duplication. Note preferred width, live sampling, group membership, canvas envelope and paint still reconstruct overlapping models, which causes demonstrated shadow/padding discrepancies. Legacy group_band_get_width is now bypassed by page_text_center on the non-Teoz path while the old midpoint model survives for Teoz.
